lines: 【脑子寄存处】
【家族文，半爽文，非无敌流，本书主角可能太过冷酷残暴，可能会引起你的不适，慎入！
【境界从低往高：锻体、肉身、气血、先天、神府（后续待定）突破气血境后可以延寿到一百三十岁，气血大圆满能活两百岁】
【天赋：一等为最高，九等最低】
大周朝。
扬州，升龙府，白河县。
在白河县的东北角，有一个广袤的天然山谷。
谷内，排排青枫树笔直挺立，宛若山谷的天然卫士，当地人称之为青枫谷。
两百年前，有一李姓家族迁徙至此，落地生根。
历经两百年发展，成为白河县鼎鼎有名的豪强——【青枫李氏】。
然而，今日的青枫谷内，却是尽皆缟素。
来往的李家族人，披麻戴孝，脸上都写满了悲痛，神情中，更是透着茫然与不安。
这一切，概因为三天前，青枫李氏当代家主李玄风被发现暴毙于闭关室中。
李玄风已经很久没有在人前现身了，久到外界都已经起了疑心，外界甚至传闻其已经坐化。
直到李家实在顶不住压力了，呼唤未果后，才进入了他的闭关室，发现他已死去多日。
他的死，太过突然。
因为李玄风不仅是青枫李氏的家主，更是青枫李氏的最强者。
在新的一辈还没成长起来的情况下，他的死去，对青枫李氏来说，是一个巨大的打击。
甚至可以说，会让现在堪称如日中天的李家，盛极而衰。
因为李玄风活着的时候，为了家族的扩张，得罪了太多人。
李家的风评在白河县可不怎么好，一向以霸道着称。
李玄风的灵堂内，人头攒动。
众多李家族人身着麻衣，聚在灵堂。
关系好的扎堆在一起，低声议论着：“老家主这一死，我李家以后的日子可就不好过了。”
“那可不，老家主是我李家唯一一位冲破了气血天关的强者，以后家族没有了他这位气血境强者坐镇，我李家又该如何震慑宵小？”
“听说，邹、张两家得知老家主死讯，已经开始不安分了。”
“他们早就对坊市的利益分配不满了，在以前，还忌惮老家主的实力，只能老老实实的，现在老家主死了，没了顾忌，自然要图穷匕见了。”
“邹、张两家，跳梁小丑，以我李家的实力，有何惧之？”
“话虽是这么说，但你又怎么能知道，他们后面没有人撑腰呢？”
“只可惜新家主才十七岁，不然以他的天赋，若再给他十年时间，冲破气血天关晋升气血境是板上钉钉之事，到时候所有问题就都迎刃而解了。”
“想的倒是挺美，但我李家的敌人哪还会给我们十年的时间？”

【Brain Storage】
[Family novel, semi-refreshing novel, not an invincible novel. The protagonist of this book may be too cold and cruel, which may cause you discomfort. Please read with caution!
[The realms from low to high: body training, physical body, qi and blood, innate, and divine palace (the follow-up is to be determined). After breaking through the qi and blood realm, you can extend your life to 130 years old, and you can live to 200 years old if you have perfect qi and blood.]
[Talent: Level 1 is the highest, Level 9 is the lowest]
Great Zhou Dynasty.
Yangzhou, Thanglong Prefecture, Baihe County.
In the northeast corner of Baihe County, there is a vast natural valley.
In the valley, rows of green maple trees stand upright like natural guards of the valley. The locals call it Green Maple Valley.
Two hundred years ago, a family named Li migrated here and took root.
After two hundred years of development, it has become a famous powerhouse in Baihe County - [Qingfeng Li Family].
...
However, everything in Qingfeng Valley today is plain.
The people of the Li family who were coming and going were all wearing sackcloth and mourning, their faces were full of sorrow, and their expressions were full of confusion and uneasiness.
All this happened because three days ago, Li Xuanfeng, the contemporary head of the Qingfeng Li family, was found dead in a retreat room.
Li Xuanfeng has not appeared in front of people for a long time. It has been so long that the outside world has become suspicious. There are even rumors that he has passed away.
It was not until the Li family could no longer withstand the pressure and called to no avail that they entered his retreat room and found that he had been dead for many days.
His death was too sudden.
Because Li Xuanfeng is not only the head of the Qingfeng Li family, but also the strongest member of the Qingfeng Li family.
Before the new generation had grown up, his death was a huge blow to the Qingfeng Li family.
It can even be said that it will make the Li family, which is now at its peak, prosper and decline.
Because when Li Xuanfeng was alive, he offended too many people for the expansion of his family.
The reputation of the Li family is not very good in Baihe County, and they have always been known for being domineering.
...
Li Xuanfeng's mourning hall was crowded with people.
Many members of the Li family, dressed in sackcloth, gathered in the mourning hall.
People with good connections gathered together and whispered: "If the old family leader dies, the life of my Li family will not be easy in the future."
"No, the old master is the only strong man in my Li family who has broken through the Qi and Blood Heavenly Barrier. In the future, without him, a strong Qi and Blood Realm, in charge of the family, how can our Li family intimidate Xiao Xiao?"
"Alas..."
"I heard that the Zou and Zhang families have become restless after learning about the death of their old master."
"They have long been dissatisfied with the distribution of interests in Fangshi. In the past, they were still afraid of the strength of the old patriarch, so they could only act honestly. Now that the old patriarch is dead, they no longer have any scruples, so they naturally want to take advantage of the situation."
"The Zou and Zhang families are clowns. With the strength of my Li family, what should I fear?"
"That being said, how do you know that there is no one behind them to support them?"
"This..."
"It's a pity that the new head of the family is only seventeen years old. Otherwise, with his talent, if he is given another ten years, it will be a sure thing to break through the Qi and Blood Heavenly Gate and advance to the Qi and Blood Realm. By then, all problems will be solved."
"It's a beautiful thought, but how can the enemies of my Li family give us ten years?"
